seo.title: AI Chef Pro Integrations: Connect Gmail, Sheets, Instagram and 13 More
seo.description: Your AI agents already work inside the tools you use: Gmail, Google Sheets, Instagram, Notion, Canva… You ask by talking, authorize once, and done.
seo.keywords: ai chef pro integrations, connect gmail restaurant ai, ai agents for hospitality, ai assistant for restaurants, composio, gastronomy automation

hero.h1: Your AI agents now work inside your own tools
hero.sub: Up until now, whatever you generated in AI Chef Pro had to be copied and pasted by hand. That's over: connect your Gmail, Google Sheets, Instagram or Notion accounts and ask the agent by talking, just like you'd ask someone on your team.

pasos.title: Three steps, and the third one isn't yours
pasos.sub: There's no settings panel to study or integrations to set up beforehand. The connection appears the moment you need it.

items.d: Inside the chat, in your own language: “I want to send this recipe by email via Gmail,” “put this table into Google Sheets,” “post this image to Instagram.”
The first time you use each service, the agent sets up the connection and asks for permission in the platform's own official window. You authorize with your account; you never give us your password.
The email goes out, the spreadsheet gets created, the photo gets posted. And the authorization is saved: it won't ask you again until it expires and needs renewing.

extras.title: And on top of that, all agents just got smarter
extras.sub: The connection to your accounts came along with two other improvements you'll notice from the very first conversation.

items.d: Agents now think before answering: they analyze the context, weigh options, and build the response. You notice it especially in anything with numbers involved—food cost breakdowns, menu engineering, business plans—where you used to have to ask follow-ups to fine-tune.

Chat agents create and edit artifacts: documents, tables, data visualizations, interactive components, and HTML or CSS files. Instead of a wall of text, they give you something you can keep tweaking in the same conversation. Recipes and food cost breakdowns are left out: they have their own specialized actions, which are better for that.

seguridad.title: Your credentials are yours
parrafos: Each connection is authorized in the service's official window: Google, Meta, or Notion themselves ask you whether to allow access. AI Chef Pro never sees or stores your password.

Authorization is requested only when you need it—nothing to set up in advance—and it stays active until it expires. You can revoke it anytime from your service account, and the agent loses access instantly.
bullets: Official authorization from each platform, using your own credentials
We never ask for or store passwords
Permissions limited to what the agent needs to do
Revocable at any time from the service itself

items.q: How do I tell the agent to use one of my accounts?
items.a: Just talk to it in the chat. Phrases like “I want to send this recipe by email via Gmail,” “put this table into Google Sheets,” or “post this image to Instagram” are enough. There's nothing to activate beforehand and no commands to learn: the agent recognizes the intent and sets up the connection itself.

items.q: Do I have to connect my accounts before I start?
items.a: No. Authorization kicks in the moment you ask for something that needs it. The first time you use each service, you'll see that platform's permission window; from then on, the agent can work with it.

items.q: How often do I have to reauthorize?
items.a: Only when the authorization expires. While it's still valid, the agent reuses it and doesn't ask again. When it expires, it'll ask you to renew it with the same couple of clicks as the first time.

items.q: Is it safe? Who can see my data?
items.a: You grant permission in the service's official window, not in one of our forms, so your password never goes through AI Chef Pro. Access is limited to what the agent needs to do, and you can revoke it anytime from your account settings on Google, Meta, Notion, or whichever platform it is.

items.q: What is Composio and why does it appear here?
items.a: Composio is the layer that manages connections with external platforms: it handles authorization, renews permissions, and makes sure each tool responds reliably. It's not another tool for your daily work; it's what makes the other sixteen work from the chat.

items.q: Is it included in my plan?
items.a: Yes. Connections, advanced reasoning, and artifacts are available to all AI Chef Pro users, at no extra cost and with no separate module.

cierre.title: Open an agent and ask it to send something
cierre.sub: The fastest way to understand it is to use it: generate a food cost breakdown and say “put this into Google Sheets.” Two authorization clicks and it's in your Drive.
